summary: Foundation task with no business logic to unit-test. The locale parity gate (scripts/check-locales.mjs, wired as pnpm prebuild) is correctly treated as the test for this task, and it passes cleanly (exit 0) against the seeded uk.json/en.json. All four namespaces (subscribers, tags, customFields, exports) carry an identical key set in both locales, with real translated values (no empty-string stubs). Every i18n key referenced by the layout sub-nav (layout.sidebar.subscribers, subscribers.subnav.subscribers, tags.subnav.tags, customFields.subnav.customFields) and by the four page shells (subscribers.title, subscribers.profile.identityCard.title, tags.title, customFields.title) resolves in both files. Deferring page-shell/component specs to Wave 4 Task 10/11 is the right call — writing unit tests for ~5-line empty SFCs or generated shadcn-vue boilerplate would be over-testing per the test pyramid. The optional namespace-presence safety-net spec is correctly skippable: it would be strictly redundant with the parity gate, and the existing tests/i18n/required-keys.spec.ts already establishes the targeted-key-presence pattern for any future regression that matters. No genuine test/verification gaps found.
